messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of the “most important” signal generation capabilities for AI applications; the AI-server source is only an R&S sales/test-solution mapping and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [72].
### AI-related needs actually documented
| AI / AI-server need in the passages | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| High-speed channel and interconnect validation | R&S ZNA/ZNB are mapped to PCB insertion loss, TDR, high-speed trace, GPU TDR, and high-speed cable testing in AI-server ecosystem contexts [71]. |
| Clock, jitter, phase-noise, and LDO noise testing | R&S FSWP is mapped to LDO NSD, clock jitter, and jitter/phase-noise tests in server motherboard, networking switch, PSU, and IC/high-speed transmission contexts [73]. |
| Power integrity and PDN validation | R&S ZNL is mapped to PDN Target Z, MXO to power rail / multiphase DC / PI, and ZISO appears in server motherboard and power-supply categories [75]. |
### Signal generation capabilities to check when the AI application also needs RF / wireless / high-speed waveform generation
| Capability | Supported examples from the passages |
|---|---|
| Wide RF frequency range and high RF modulation bandwidth | R&S SMM100A covers frequency options up to 44 GHz and internal RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz [91]; R&S SMW200A wideband baseband supports RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz [28]. |
| Arbitrary waveform generation, replay, and sequencing | CMX500 GPRF Generator supports ARB, CW, dual tone, replay of `.wv` files, up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel, ARB Sequencer, and direct upload in the configuration sidebar [8]. |
| Large ARB memory / high sample rate / wide ARB bandwidth | SMBV100B ARB supports waveform length up to 2 Gsample, sample rate up to 1200 MHz, and ARB RF bandwidth up to 1000 MHz with the listed extensions [83]. |
| Real-time baseband and custom digital modulation | SMM100A positioning includes internal real-time signal generation, arbitrary waveform generator, and custom digital modulation [22]; SMBV100B K520 baseband real-time extension supports ASK, FSK, MSK, PSK, APSK, and QAM up to 4096QAM [83]. |
| MIMO and fading scenarios | SMW200A supports up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths with SGT100A modules, and MIMO fading scenarios including 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8, and 2x4x4 [28]. |
| AWGN and impairment generation | SMBV100B K62 adds AWGN with settable bandwidth and C/N or Eb/N0 [16]; SMM100A K62 is the AWGN option [92]. |
| Envelope tracking, predistortion, crest-factor reduction, and notched signals | SMBV100B supports envelope tracking, AM/AM and AM/φM predistortion, crest factor reduction, and notched signals through listed baseband enhancement options [17]. |
| Phase-coherent multi-instrument generation | SMBV100B K90 enables phase-coherent RF outputs for two or more instruments in I/Q mode [84]; SMM100A B90 provides phase-coherent RF outputs for two or more instruments [95]. |
| Digital I/Q interfaces for high-speed baseband connectivity | SMCV100B K19 provides Dig. I/Q HS digital baseband input/output over QSFP+/QSFP 28 with 16-bit I/Q data and RF bandwidth of 0.8 × sample rate [56]; CMX-B200A provides two full-duplex high-speed digital I/Q interfaces at 40 Gbps over QSFP+ [57]. |
| Standard-specific wireless waveform generation | CMX500 technology-specific ARB licenses cover GNSS, Bluetooth, WLAN 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn, GSM, WCDMA, LTE, NB-IoT, NR Rel. 15/16, NR Rel. 17, NR C-V2X, and AWGN [65]. |
### Inference
【推論】For AI-server hardware work, the passages more directly document SI/interconnect, jitter/phase-noise, and power-integrity needs than signal-generation needs [71][73][75].
【推論】If the AI application includes wireless, FR2, WLAN, GNSS, or RF subsystem testing, the signal-generation capabilities to prioritize are wide RF/modulation bandwidth, ARB replay/creation, real-time baseband, MIMO/fading, AWGN/impairments, phase coherence, and digital I/Q connectivity, because those are the documented capabilities across SMM100A, SMW200A, SMBV100B, CMX500, and SMCV100B [22][28][56][57][65][83][91].

依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301 › 規格適用條件與資料等級
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage 3 hours、warm-up operation 30 minutes、specified environmental conditions met、recommended calibration interval adhered to、all applicable internal automatic adjustments performed。
- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、± 或 maximum / limit of / minimum 等方式表示。
- Specifications with limits 的符合性由 testing 確保，或由 design 推導；test limits 會以 guard bands 收窄以納入 measurement uncertainties、drift、aging。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證該 product performance。
- Specifications without limits 表示指定 parameter 的 warranted product performance；未特別標示時表示該值無偏差或偏差可忽略，符合性由 design 確保。
- Typical data（typ.）、nominal values（nom.）、measured values（meas.）不由 Rohde & Schwarz warranted。
- Uncertainties 使用 coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM）計算。
- 依 3GPP standard，Gbps、Mcps、Mbps、Msps、kbps、ksps、Msample/s 不是 SI units。

R&S SMM100A
[[R&S SMM100A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Signal Generator；依 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`，透過 `R&S®SMM-B10xx` frequency options 覆蓋 `100 kHz to 6 GHz` 到 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`，並支援最高 `2 GHz` internal RF modulation bandwidth、5G NR FR1/FR2、ARB、real-time baseband、custom digital modulation、envelope tracking 與 HUMS（來源：[[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]）。

⚠️ [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026）讀圖補充 p049 與 p051 頁尾說 `R&S®SMW100A Vector Signal Generator`，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說本文件產品為 `R&S®SMM100A Vector Signal Generator`。判斷為來源頁尾疑似誤植；本頁仍以封面、p050、文件名稱、ordering information 與 source_path 的 `SMM100A` 為主，並在 Unresolved 保留此不一致。

⚠️ [[R&S for JIO Project]]（2026-09-17 converted；來源未標示正式日期）說 [[R&S SMM100A]] Frequency Range: Up to 67 GHz，但既有頁面 [[R&S SMM100A]] 說依 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]]（June 2026 / May 2026 未決）SMM100A 最高 frequency option 為 100 kHz to 44 GHz。判斷：[[R&S for JIO Project]] 是 Market / project deck，且同一簡報 slide 24 另列 [[R&S SMA100B]] 8 kHz to 67 GHz；因此 67 GHz 很可能是簡報混淆或 sales-slide 錯植。正式規格以 [[SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100]] 為準，Jio WoMT use-case 中引用此簡報時需保留矛盾。

SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S SMM100A]]：本來源的主要產品實體。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：製造商。
- [[Vector signal generator]]：產品類型。
- [[I-Q modulation]]：支援 external wideband I/Q 與 internal baseband I/Q，RF modulation bandwidth 依 frequency option 與頻率最高到 `±1 GHz`；產品描述稱 internal RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`。
- [[Arbitrary waveform generator]]：需 `R&S®SMM-B9` baseband generator with ARB，standard `64 Msample`、`120 MHz RF bandwidth`，可用 keycode options 擴充 memory、sample rate 與 RF bandwidth。
- [[AWGN]]：`R&S®SMM-K62`。
- [[Envelope tracking]]：`R&S®SMM-K540`，requires `R&S®SMM-K17` and `R&S®SMM-B9`。
- [[SCPI]]：remote control command set 為 `SCPI 1999.5 or compatible command sets`。
- [[HUMS]]：`R&S®SMM-K980` Health and utilization monitoring service。

SMM100A_specs_en_3608-7680-22_v3100 › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S SMM100A]] 屬於 Rohde & Schwarz signal generator / vector signal generator 產品線，功能定位高於或不同於既有的 [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMB100B]] 與 [[R&S SMA100B]]。

- 與 [[R&S SMA100B]] / [[R&S SMB100B]] 的 analog/RF signal generator 類產品相比，本來源的 [[R&S SMM100A]] 重點在 vector modulation、internal real-time signal generation、ARB 與 digital standards。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S PVT360A › Signal generation
| Option | Order no. | 功能 |
|---|---:|---|
| R&S PVT-KW400 | 1214.0458.xx | Bluetooth waveform playback through GPRF generator |

依 [[PVT360A_Features_V8-5-30_en_06]]，Bluetooth signal generation 支援：

- Bluetooth specification 4.2 的 basic rate、enhanced data rate、low energy mode。
- BR/EDR transport modes：ACL+EDR、SCO、eSCO+EDR。
- BR/EDR packet types 包含 ID、NULL、POLL、FHS、DMx、DHx、AUX1、2-DHx、3-DHx、HVx、DV、EVx。
- LE packet format：LE 1M、LE 2M、LE coded。
- LE advertising extensions、direction finding with AoA/AoD。

R&S PVT360A › Waveform playback
| Option | Order no. | 功能 |
|---|---:|---|
| R&S PVT-KW410 | 1214.0464.xx | WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/ac waveform playback |
| R&S PVT-KW411 | 1214.0470.xx | WLAN 802.11ax extension；需要 R&S PVT-KW410 |
| R&S PVT-KW412 | 1214.0487.xx | WLAN 802.11be extension；需要 R&S PVT-KW411 |
| R&S PVT-KW414 | 1214.4499.xx | WLAN 802.11bn UHR extension；需要 R&S PVT-KW412 |

WLAN waveform generation 來源摘錄：

- 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p：依 IEEE 802.11-2016；bandwidth 20 MHz、40 MHz；最多 4 transmit antennas。
- 802.11ac：依 IEEE 802.11ac-2013；bandwidth up to 160 MHz；最多 8 spatial streams / antennas；支援 MU-MIMO。
- 802.11ax：依 IEEE P802.11ax；最多 8 antennas；MU-MIMO users 1 to 8；max total users 138；支援 4096QAM MCS 12/13。
- 802.11be：依 IEEE P802.11be；bandwidth up to 320 MHz；支援 EHT MU / trigger-based、4096QAM。
- 802.11bn：ultra high reliability / UHR；詳細資訊需參考 R&S WinIQSIM2 IEEE 802.11 user manual。

- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co. KG]]：R&S registered trademark 所屬組織；地址標示為 Muehldorfstr. 15, 81671 Muenchen, Germany。

- [[R&S VSE]]：Vector Signal Explorer analysis software；來源指出 supported instruments 包含 PVT360A。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]]：用於產生 waveform files，PVT360A hardware 播放 waveform files 時受 frequency range、bandwidth、ARB memory 與 sample clock 等限制。

PVT360A Features and Functions Version 06 › Bluetooth options
Bluetooth signal generation：

| Option | Order no. | 摘要 |
|---|---:|---|
| R&S PVT-KW400 | 1214.0458.xx | GPRF generator 播放 Bluetooth waveform files；符合 Bluetooth specification 4.2，支援 BR、EDR、LE；LE 另涵蓋 5.3 相關 advertising extensions 與 AoA/AoD direction finding |

Bluetooth measurements：

| Option | Order no. | 摘要 |
|---|---:|---|
| R&S PVT-KM400 | 1214.0335.xx | 提供 Bluetooth signals up to version 5.3 的 multi-evaluation measurements；支援 classic v4.2、LE v5.0、LE v5.1、list mode、OTA RX LE v4.2、DTM RX LE v5.0 |

Bluetooth generation 與 measurement 涵蓋重點：

- BR/EDR：支援 ACL+EDR、SCO、eSCO+EDR transport modes；packet types 包含 ID、NULL、POLL、FHS、DMx、DHx、AUX1、2-DHx、3-DHx、HVx、DV、EVx 等。
- LE：支援 advertising channel、data channel、LE test packets；packet format 包含 LE 1M、LE 2M、LE coded。
- Dirty transmitter / dirty transmission test 可設定 frequency drift、carrier frequency offset、symbol timing error、modulation index 等。
- Classic v4.2 multi-evaluation 支援 BR / EDR TX tests，並提供 power vs time、modulation、spectrum、phase encoding、ACP 等結果。
- LE v5.0 multi-evaluation 支援 LE 1M、LE 2M、LE coded PHY transmitter tests，以及 advertiser packets。
- LE v5.1 支援 CTE portion TX tests，包含 AoA / AoD slot type、CTE units、antenna 數等設定。
- OTA RX measurements LE v4.2 支援 spot check、PER measurement、sensitivity search。
- DTM RX measurements LE v5.0 支援 PER measurements 與 PER search measurements，透過 USB interface 控制 DUT。

| Option | Order no. | 摘要 |

來源涵蓋：

- GSM EDGE R6 waveform，符合 3GPP TS 45.001 / 45.002 / 45.004 v.9.0.0。
- GSM R7 EDGEevo waveform，包含 EDGE Evolution / EDGE+ features 與 VAMOS。
- GSM MS measurements 對 GMSK、8PSK、16QAM-modulated normal bursts 與 access bursts 提供 multi-evaluation measurement。
- GSM measurement results 包含 modulation、power vs time、spectrum due to modulation、spectrum due to switching、BER，以及 list mode per segment results。
- RF frequency 依 hardware 而定，涵蓋 GSM 450、GSM 480、T-GSM 810、GSM 850、MXM 850、P/R/ER/E-GSM 900、DCS 1800、PCS 1900、MXM 1900。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of the “most important” signal generation capabilities for AI applications; the AI-server source is only an R&S sales/test-solution mapping and does not represent formal product configuration, customer relationship, or verified opportunity [72].
### AI-related needs actually documented
| AI / AI-server need in the passages | What the passages support |
|---|---|
| High-speed channel and interconnect validation | R&S ZNA/ZNB are mapped to PCB insertion loss, TDR, high-speed trace, GPU TDR, and high-speed cable testing in AI-server ecosystem contexts [71]. |
| Clock, jitter, phase-noise, and LDO noise testing | R&S FSWP is mapped to LDO NSD, clock jitter, and jitter/phase-noise tests in server motherboard, networking switch, PSU, and IC/high-speed transmission contexts [73]. |
| Power integrity and PDN validation | R&S ZNL is mapped to PDN Target Z, MXO to power rail / multiphase DC / PI, and ZISO appears in server motherboard and power-supply categories [75]. |
### Signal generation capabilities to check when the AI application also needs RF / wireless / high-speed waveform generation
| Capability | Supported examples from the passages |
|---|---|
| Wide RF frequency range and high RF modulation bandwidth | R&S SMM100A covers frequency options up to 44 GHz and internal RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz [91]; R&S SMW200A wideband baseband supports RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz [28]. |
| Arbitrary waveform generation, replay, and sequencing | CMX500 GPRF Generator supports ARB, CW, dual tone, replay of `.wv` files, up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel, ARB Sequencer, and direct upload in the configuration sidebar [8]. |
| Large ARB memory / high sample rate / wide ARB bandwidth | SMBV100B ARB supports waveform length up to 2 Gsample, sample rate up to 1200 MHz, and ARB RF bandwidth up to 1000 MHz with the listed extensions [83]. |
| Real-time baseband and custom digital modulation | SMM100A positioning includes internal real-time signal generation, arbitrary waveform generator, and custom digital modulation [22]; SMBV100B K520 baseband real-time extension supports ASK, FSK, MSK, PSK, APSK, and QAM up to 4096QAM [83]. |
| MIMO and fading scenarios | SMW200A supports up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths with SGT100A modules, and MIMO fading scenarios including 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8, and 2x4x4 [28]. |
| AWGN and impairment generation | SMBV100B K62 adds AWGN with settable bandwidth and C/N or Eb/N0 [16]; SMM100A K62 is the AWGN option [92]. |
| Envelope tracking, predistortion, crest-factor reduction, and notched signals | SMBV100B supports envelope tracking, AM/AM and AM/φM predistortion, crest factor reduction, and notched signals through listed baseband enhancement options [17]. |
| Phase-coherent multi-instrument generation | SMBV100B K90 enables phase-coherent RF outputs for two or more instruments in I/Q mode [84]; SMM100A B90 provides phase-coherent RF outputs for two or more instruments [95]. |
| Digital I/Q interfaces for high-speed baseband connectivity | SMCV100B K19 provides Dig. I/Q HS digital baseband input/output over QSFP+/QSFP 28 with 16-bit I/Q data and RF bandwidth of 0.8 × sample rate [56]; CMX-B200A provides two full-duplex high-speed digital I/Q interfaces at 40 Gbps over QSFP+ [57]. |
| Standard-specific wireless waveform generation | CMX500 technology-specific ARB licenses cover GNSS, Bluetooth, WLAN 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn, GSM, WCDMA, LTE, NB-IoT, NR Rel. 15/16, NR Rel. 17, NR C-V2X, and AWGN [65]. |
### Inference
【推論】For AI-server hardware work, the passages more directly document SI/interconnect, jitter/phase-noise, and power-integrity needs than signal-generation needs [71][73][75].
【推論】If the AI application includes wireless, FR2, WLAN, GNSS, or RF subsystem testing, the signal-generation capabilities to prioritize are wide RF/modulation bandwidth, ARB replay/creation, real-time baseband, MIMO/fading, AWGN/impairments, phase coherence, and digital I/Q connectivity, because those are the documented capabilities across SMM100A, SMW200A, SMBV100B, CMX500, and SMCV100B [22][28][56][57][65][83][91].
